mechanism: Issue #142 (M3): a TRAIN-only local curvature profile supervises a head on the quantized readout, and a support-limited relational term asks similar roles to stay close

calls.name: mixed cost of one joint codeword
calls.note: The continuous surface of the mechanism: the cost the assignment is taken over, with the curved codeword already mapped into the ball. It is the only differentiable place the weight alpha lives. The two-dimensional width is a slice of the sixteen-dimensional halves; the formula is dimension-free.

calls.name: profile penalty on one standardised coordinate
calls.note: The continuous surface of this mechanism: the Huber of the head's prediction against the frozen TRAIN profile coordinate. Its gradient reaches the head, the codebooks and the encoder through the quantized readout.

coupling.note: The frozen TRAIN profile coordinate moves the objective the quantizer is trained against, and the prediction argument is the quantized readout, so the movement is not a re-parameterisation of the geometry. tests/test_gradient.py shows the same readout with two different profiles producing two different gradients.
